name: B10-0424/2026 – § 7 – Am 96
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 7.Calls on the Commission and the Member States to support civil society actors, including organisations, intellectuals, association leaders and to protect and sustain racialised and migrant-led civil society organisations on the front lines of the fight for racial justice through sustainable funding and to ensure their full participation and representation in all relevant frameworks;
